{"change_type":"defect_fix","commits":"7f0f2086c,34f767c44,f9598298b","detected_at":"2026-10-13","name":"Built work reads as built: a Component's built_reading, the owner's awaiting_word list, and the ship step closes the idea it answers","rationale":"The finding (fact:root-cause-built-work-stays-open-because-its-record-is-kept-by-hand-and-the-ship-moves-only-the-capability-2026-10-13) named the class: a status kept by hand at a not-done default, whose truth the engine already computes, and which nothing moves at the act that makes it true. understated_status (2026-09-30) only reported the lag, in one roll-up a reader of get_node never saw. The correction works at each of the three places the class showed, without writing anyone's status, since moving one is the owner's word. A reader now gets the computed truth beside the record, one computation shared with the detector so the two cannot disagree. The ship instruction now asks for the edge the promotion detector reads, at the ship rather than only at promotion (47 of 59 ideas the 10-13 judgement pass found built lacked it). And what awaits the owner's word is listed with its evidence, as one additive read the accepted approval page (dec:idea-an-owner-reads-what-they-are-asked-to-approve-in-one-addressed-digest) can build on.

Choices, and why. The field is built_reading because decorate() already adds one computed-on-read fact to every node (discontinued), and reading is the schema's word for a derived meaning. reads_as is derived_report's word for a relation's reading. The values avoid the status words, so the reading cannot be taken for the owner's record or copied into it. The list rides loop_status's scoped answer, not what_next: the scoped answer already lists the other two families an owner is asked for (assigned_decisions, questions_put_to_them), while what_next takes no person and ranks decisions only. Unscoped it is empty, so the call every session makes costs what it did. An item's closing sentence was cut after measuring: 51 items at about 770 bytes each, mostly a 190-byte sentence repeated per item, which is now said once in the scoped next.

Reconciled with the finding's numbers, by id. Components: the finding counted 88 of 107 planned with a built capability or ANY realizing file; the reading counts 87, the extra one being sub:serving, whose only evidence is a file whose own status says nothing (not a build, fact:a-planned-artifact-that-realizes-a-capability-is-counted-as-built-2026-09-28). 89 of all 109 read built or partly built, the 87 plus the 2 already realized. Requirements: the finding's 33 of 82 proposed was taken at c58305ba8; on main 26 of those 82 have since been ruled (9 accepted, 8 dropped, 9 deferred), leaving 56 proposed. 33 of them have a realized or verified satisfying capability, and all 33 are in the list. The list holds 38: the 33 plus 5 delivered through capabilities whose own status lags (req:a-rule-is-recorded-with-its-consequence, req:an-assigned-open-decision-is-reported, req:hosted-state-outlives-the-image, req:pr-is-a-delta, req:the-loop-says-what-is-owed-to-a-person), because delivery is read from the thread (BL-104), not from a status. Ideas: the 13 decision_overtaken_by_promotion reports, the same population.

Not done, by the brief: no requirement, decision or component status moved; closing what reads as built is the owner's word. Whether a later ship follows the new instruction is not measured here.
